import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Function;

public class Lambdas {
    int base = 2;

    int apply(List<Integer> values) {
        Function<Integer, Integer> twice = x -> x * 2;
        Function<Integer, Integer> plus = (a) -> a + base;
        Runnable nothing = () -> { base++; };
        values.forEach(v -> {
            int doubled = twice.apply(v);
            base += doubled;
        });
        Function<String, Integer> length = String::length;
        return values.stream().map(plus).mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum() + length.apply("abc");
    }

    <T extends Comparable<T>> T larger(T left, T right) {
        return left.compareTo(right) > 0 ? left : right;
    }
}
